resolution: This result uses only exact extensional classification relative to an explicit data projection. It distinguishes that stipulated property from Wittgenstein’s grammatical discussion of an independent criterion (PI I.258/I.265), a computable checking procedure, epistemic warrant, normative authority and social consensus. Neither public agreement nor a private seeming is identified with correctness. An unavailable criterion may exist extensionally; a criterion’s existence does not justify reliance on it.
note: The equivalence does not formalize or decide the private-language argument.
